name: Egens unius
gloss: the needy one, of a single part
wiring_note: One rung at shape converts it outright and nothing else is needed. The seam is the variant: the frame must name a METHOD. The same seat filled with the manner variant is a different animal entirely and a toxic one, so the part that defines this creature and the part that defines Obtemperans habitui are the same key with different data. It is the commonest creature in the first world and the one that makes the architecture look easy, which is exactly the lesson it will mislead a player into.

fuel.law: IV. Four rods, three plants, three size tiers: ollama/granite4.1:8b, nvidia/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct, nvidia/mistralai/mistral-small-4-119b-2603 and groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile all carry the same total split. Same composition, different fuel, same organism here, which is rare in this lab.
